title: Hello and introduce yourself
instructions: Tap Listen. Then use the microphone and repeat the sentence clearly.
expected_text: Hello, my name is Alex. Nice to meet you.

title: About you
prompt: What is your name and where are you from?
instructions: Answer in one or two short sentences.

title: Daily routine
instructions: Speak naturally and try not to rush.
expected_text: I usually get up at seven, have breakfast, and go to work by bus.

title: Weekend plans
prompt: What are you going to do this weekend?

title: A useful experience
prompt: Describe something useful you learned recently.
instructions: Give a short answer with a reason or example.

title: At a hotel
prompt: You arrive at a hotel. Ask to check in and confirm your reservation.
instructions: Speak as if you were talking to the receptionist.

title: Remote work
prompt: What are one advantage and one disadvantage of remote work?
instructions: Give a balanced answer and support both points.

title: Polite disagreement
prompt: A colleague proposes launching a project before user testing is complete. Respond politely and explain your concern.
instructions: Use diplomatic disagreement and propose an alternative.

title: Nuanced position
prompt: Should important public decisions rely mainly on quantitative indicators?
instructions: Give a nuanced response, acknowledge a counterargument, and qualify your conclusion.
